generation.explanation: Detects a full test-suite retry after a prior collection failure was followed by a successful dependency installation.

selection.hypothesis: For repository-wide test commands, predict an early dependency-gated failure mode versus a genuine full-suite execution mode from causally earlier exit status/result excerpts and successful dependency-install commands. The early-failure mode has low latency/resources, while the same command after missing dependencies are installed reaches high latency, CPU, and RSS; Current repeatedly conflates these modes.
selection.why_agent_needed: An agent must interpret bounded earlier results to determine whether prior full-suite attempts stopped on missing imports and whether subsequent installs succeeded; command structure alone cannot distinguish the two execution modes.
